title: Grade 1 Mathematics TLM – Wall Charts for Rote Learning (Multiplication, Ordinals, Numerals & More)

sessions.title: Complete Multiplication Grid 2-12 – Wall Chart
indicators: Use the grid to find any multiplication fact from 2x2 to 12x12 by crossing row and column
Recite multiplication facts by tracing along the chart
Identify patterns: squares on the diagonal, symmetry
Work in pairs to quiz each other using the grid (collaboration)
Display the grid digitally for practice (digital literacy)
Apply quick recall of facts to solve problems (personal development)
sessions.content:
Multiplication Wall Chart – Look, Follow, Remember

This is the big table you paste on the classroom wall. Find the number on the left (row) and the number on the top (column). Where they meet is the answer. For example, 6 x 7: go to row 6, column 7, answer is 42.

x23456789101112
24681012141618202224
369121518212427303336
4812162024283236404448
51015202530354045505560
61218243036424854606672
71421283542495663707784
81624324048566472808896
918273645546372819099108
102030405060708090100110120
112233445566778899110121132
1224364860728496108120132144

How to use: Find the row number, move your finger across to the column number. Read the answer aloud. Do this every day.

Activity: In pairs, one pupil gives a multiplication (e.g., 7 x 8), the other finds it on the chart and says the answer. Switch roles. (collaboration).

Digital corner: Use an interactive multiplication grid online that highlights the row and column when you tap. (digital literacy).

sessions.title: Ordinal Numbers 1st to 20th – Wall Chart
indicators: Read ordinal numbers from 1st to 20th in order
Match ordinal numerals to words
Use ordinals to describe position in a line or race
Practice daily recitation of ordinals (personal development)
